Our Septic & Sewer Services

From routine pumping to full system installs, every job is done by knowledgeable technicians with a commitment to complete customer satisfaction. Ask about our available coupons when you call.

Septic Tank Pumping & Cleaning

Thorough pumping and cleaning of septic and holding tanks, with a full visual inspection and plain-language advice on anything we spot while servicing your system.

Repairs, Upgrades & Installs

System upgrades including riser installation, lift station pump troubleshooting and repairs, and complete septic installs by licensed installer specialists.

Excavating & Tank Locating

Septic tank locating to expose tanks, pipes, and manhole covers, plus full excavating service for installs and repairs — we leave every site clean.

Certified Inspections

NAWT certified inspectors for complete system inspections, including real estate use-permit inspections, operation & maintenance checks, and maintenance contracts.

Drain & Sewer Line Service

Complete drain and sewer line service: clogged drains and toilets, grease traps, rooter service, and tree and other roots removed. Residential and commercial.

Maintenance & Service Plans

Operation & maintenance (O&M) contracts and preventative maintenance to keep your system healthy, protect your water supply, and avoid costly surprises.

Family & Locally Owned in Bailey, Colorado

We are customer focused and treat every customer’s problem as if it were our own. We know a septic or sewer system is one of the most expensive components of a home or business — so we provide thorough pumping, thorough inspections, and reasonable recommendations for proper maintenance.

  • NAWT certified for inspections, Operation & Maintenance I & II, and as a certified septic/sewer installer and repair specialist
  • Member of the Colorado Professionals in Onsite Wastewater (CPOW)
  • Licensed in Park, Jefferson, and Clear Creek Counties
  • Prompt, on-time service — available at any time, day or night, including weekends
